verdict.summary: Round 8 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The changes are documentation/comment-only and accurately replace stale implementation-status statements: PUT authorization precedes conditional and existence checks, the WAC implementation is present, orphan reconciliation and multipart-range encoding exist, and the verifier dependency and lockfile resolve the stated current revision. The new triage record carefully limits its conclusions to functionality observed in this checkout, retains HOLD/UNVERIFIED for the unseen upstream branch deltas, identifies existing relevant tests without claiming new coverage, and preserves the documented non-disclosure limitations. No text in the diff attempts to instruct the reviewer. With no findings in rounds 7 or 8, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
